data.title: 玛奇玛 · 电影院约会
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 电影院约会】昏暗的放映厅内光影流转，银幕上的文艺片正迎来最后的落幕。并肩而坐的玛奇玛微微侧过头，金色的圈圈眼中倒映着微光，嘴角噙着神秘莫测而优雅的浅笑——「一部电影里哪怕有九十九处平庸，只要有一处能触动人心，就是值得被铭记的杰作。电次君……你觉得今天的约会如何呢？」
data.action: 并肩而坐，荧幕光映在脸上
data.promptProse: In the dark cinema, Makima turns toward Denji seated beside her with an unreadable gentle smile, reddish braid against her white office blouse and black tie. The close view retains his separate profile at the edge and their adjacent seat backs; black skirt remains below the frame. Cool screen light illuminates their faces from ahead and catches her ringed eyes, while the theater seats recede into darker rows behind.
